summary.overview: In the Catch-up and Planning Meeting between Jack and Ahmed, they began by recapping their New Year's experiences, including Jack's London fireworks views and Ahmed's insights about the city's display. The discussion then shifted to business updates, emphasizing the need to restart the TSG project and introducing a new contact, Dawn, along with Ahmed's compilation of retail companies. They reviewed potential buyers such as Zif Davis, CACI, Walmart, and Kroger, outlining outreach efforts and tasks for Jack to follow up with contacts like Jason Wooten. Project updates included the creation of a comparison report for lead generation tools and populating a draft listing. Action items were assigned, with Ahmed focusing on securing NDAs and sending out retail lists, while Jack aimed to set up calls and follow up on listings and interest in the Imaginary Content project.
summary.short_summary: Jack and Ahmed held a catch-up and planning meeting, beginning with a brief recap of their New Year's experiences, including Jack's views of the London fireworks and Ahmed's insights on the display. They then shifted their focus to business updates, emphasizing the need to restart the TSG project. During the meeting, Ahmed introduced a new contact named Dawn and shared a compilation of retail companies. They discussed potential buyers, including Zif Davis, CACI, Walmart, and Kroger, and outlined outreach efforts, with Jack tasked to follow up with Jason Wooten at Walmart. Project updates included the creation of a comparison report for lead generation tools and a review of the weekly listing draft. Action items were assigned, with Ahmed focusing on securing NDAs and sending retail lists, while Jack aimed to set up calls and follow up on the Imaginary Content project.
